scope: Read-only review of all 27 changed paths and literal live issue acceptance; no builds/tests/CI observations performed.
disposition: No concrete active production regression found; one literal acceptance/closure gap remains.

findings.title: Existing production request owner does not yet own the accounting lifecycle
findings.evidence: The helper explicitly relies on its caller to begin after exact admission and forbid replacement while live. Committed-tree usage search finds ProtectedOperation only in its Core definition/tests and the new integration test. The wire test constructs a helper locally and explicitly models the existing owner response check; no production Root-correlated compositor/service request owner calls begin/grant/finish_slice/complete/cancel_or_fault. A fresh helper would reset totals if an owner recreated it, so the anti-renewal property is not established for any existing owner by these tests.
findings.requirement: Live #6317 requires the existing Root-correlated owner to begin once after admission, retain bytes/envelope and remaining grant across transport retry/gate/resume, retire only after its complete bounded matching response validator, and revoke fault/cancel/exhaustion.
findings.recommendation: Treat this PR as the canonical contract/deterministic helper prerequisite, not full original #6317 completion, unless existing-owner deterministic integration is added. Explicitly retain the original owner-lifecycle requirement as open/owned; the appended deferral to #6311 does not itself demonstrate it. Actual interrupt/CPL3 enforcement remains correctly outside this prerequisite.

reviewed_controls.identity: Explicit scheduling tags preserve cooperative tag 0 and partitioned tag 1 byte construction; protected tag 2 fingerprints accounting profile, quantum/total and context binding/extent/alignment. Existing scheduling golden digests and absent protected-offer legacy JSON tests are substantive source controls, not independently executed here.
reviewed_controls.finite_policy: Positive quantum/total, quantum <= total, positive aligned context extent, explicit observed-source-interrupt units and missed/coalesced limitations. Private grants bind request envelope, command digest/length and checked epoch; outstanding grant equality prevents successful duplicate finish; invalid counts/exhaustion revoke. Gate is not completion; a new slice clears prior gate readiness.
reviewed_controls.admission: Exact Host/Boot/offer generation and unique pool/profile, BareMetal lane reservation/Base ownership/readiness/enforcement checks, explicit context resource class and extent, checked aggregate placements+lane+context pool accounting. Two-region shared-context-capacity negative is present.
reviewed_controls.fail_closed: Plan lowering admission lines 21-30 unconditionally refuses ProtectedPreemptibleStep; Composite and hosted preparation also refuse rather than interpreting worker storage as scheduling authority. Planner current_lowering_explicitly_refuses_new_profile asserts that boundary.
reviewed_controls.wire: Tests use actual compositor request/response codecs and reject wrong instance/request/kind/truncated/trailing response, but the production-owner invocation is absent.

proof_limits: No tests, lint, native build, runtime, interrupt enforcement, Candidate or Integration independently run or verified by this review.
All current target profiles refuse the new scheduling variant: no actual native continuation or fairness claim follows.
SHA-256/length binds command content but helper neither owns immutable transport storage nor establishes admission; these remain trusted existing-owner responsibilities.
No second production request ledger was introduced.
Merge/relevant post-merge Integration remain delivery gates, separate from this source review.
